headline: Jackson's pass, alert timeout call lead to Loop's 56-yard field goal as Ravens beat Cowboys 34-31
summary: — Lamar Jackson completed a 27-yard pass to Zay Flowers and alertly called a timeout with 1 second left, setting up Tyler Loop’s 56-yard field goal to cap a stunning 7-second drive that gave the Baltimore Ravens a 34-31 victory over the Dallas Cowboys...

headline: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield has dislocated thumb, will undergo MRI
summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield suffered a dislocated right thumb in the fourth quarter of Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings, coach Todd Bowles said.

headline: Kirk Cousins throws 3 TDs, Raiders move to 3-0 with 35-27 victory over Saints
summary: For just the second time since 2002, the Raiders are 3-0.

headline: Vikings beat Buccaneers 23-16 but lose Jefferson to an ankle injury. Bucs' Mayfield also hurt
summary: — Myles Price returned a punt 86 yards for a score, Kyler Murray threw a 41-yard TD pass to Jordan Addison and the Minnesota Vikings beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 23-16 on Sunday.

headline: Commanders snap Seattle's 12-game winning streak, beat the Seahawks 33-31
summary: — Marcus Mariota threw three touchdown passes, and Kain Medrano returned an interception 50 yards for a touchdown to help the Washington Commanders hand Seattle its first loss since November, 33-31 on Sunday.

headline: Steelers' Warren dominates Bengals with career-best 176 yards
summary: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren exploded for a career-best 176 yards from scrimmage in a dominant display for Pittsburgh's run game in Sunday's win.
